x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
After 25 days of waiting, LeBron James has made his choice.

He's signing with the Philadelphia 76ers.

2 years. $8 million.

LeBron + Embiid.

The NBA just changed.

#LeBronJames #Sixers #NBAFreeAgency

He seriously considered retirement.

The Heat. The Cavs. The Warriors. The Wolves.

All passed over.

Joel Embiid has his co-star.

#LeBronJames #Sixers #PhillyBasketball

research.facts:
LeBron James Signs with Philadelphia 76ers
**Source:** ESPN, NBA.com, Yahoo Sports — CONFIRMED multiple independent sources
**Key facts (HIGH confidence):**
- LeBron James announced July 24, 2026 he is signing with the Philadelphia 76ers
- Contract: 2 years, $8 million
- LeBron told the Lakers on June 30 he would not return after eight seasons; Lakers won 17th championship under him
- This will be LeBron's 24th NBA season
- LeBron will pair with Joel Embiid
- Described by LeBron as his "last decision" — had seriously considered retirement
- Finalists: Cleveland Cavaliers, Miami Heat, Philadelphia 76ers, Minnesota Timberwolves, Golden State Warriors
- Heat had accidentally published a YouTube event "LeBron James Introductory Press Conference" on July 24, deleted it (prior reporting from July 24 daily brief)
- Quote: LeBron stated "I still want to compete, to win"

stories.title: Wembanyama + Fox = Spurs Dynasty Core Locked In

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Victor Wembanyama left $51 million on the table.

He took the 25% max instead of the 30% supermax.

Why? To give San Antonio cap flexibility to build a winner.

At 21 years old.

The Spurs' dynasty pipeline is not a maybe anymore.

#Spurs #Wembanyama

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Wembanyama: 5 years, $252M — done.

De'Aaron Fox: 4 years, $228M — done.

Both locked in San Antonio. Both in their prime years.

Forbes called it a potential "balance of power" shift for the NBA.

The Spurs are back.

#Spurs #NBA

research.facts:
Wembanyama 5-Year $252M Extension + De'Aaron Fox 4-Year $228M Extension
**Source:** ESPN, NBA.com, Al Jazeera, CBS Sports, Forbes — CONFIRMED multiple independent sources
**Key facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Victor Wembanyama signed 5-year, $252 million extension with San Antonio Spurs on July 10, 2026
- $50.4M per year average
- Wembanyama accepted 25% max rather than 30% supermax ($303M); voluntarily left ~$51 million on table
- Extra cap space provided to Spurs: estimated $50M over life of deal
- Deal is third-largest rookie extension in NBA history (behind Cade Cunningham 5yr/$269M and Evan Mobley 5yr/$269M)
- Player option on fifth season
- De'Aaron Fox signed 4-year, $228M extension with San Antonio Spurs in same offseason window
- Forbes framing: "Victor Wembanyama's New Contract Could Break The NBA's Balance Of Power"
**Image search terms (imagn):** "Victor Wembanyama San Antonio Spurs" / "De'Aaron Fox San Antonio Spurs"
